pattern: IM-T02 tenant self-fix, landlord told; CP-03 landlord confirms the tenant's machine stays and nothing more is needed; CP-12 final checks
notes: Events 001-009 unchanged; history truncated after 009 and four events appended. 010 and 011 are the agency's emails of 24 December telling the landlord (and confirming to the tenant) that the tenant swapped in their own machine, his is in the garage, nobody has been sent, and asking what he wants done. 012 (24 Dec 15:20, Update) and 013 (same time, Email landlord): Oliver is happy for the tenant's machine to stay for the rest of the tenancy as theirs to look after, does not want his ten-year-old machine repaired, will collect it from the garage himself in the new year and arrange a time with the tenant, and confirms nothing further is needed from the agency. Every party is informed and nothing is outstanding. Expected: record the landlord's decision, note the inventory change (tenant-owned machine in use, landlord's machine in the garage awaiting his collection), give the tenant a short update, and close without payment. Escalating or sending anyone is wrong.
